question: Implement self-training with SVM to classify cell types. Use a 70/30 train-test split, then treat only 20% of the training set as labeled and the remaining 80% as unlabeled. Iteratively add predictions with confidence >= 0.8 back to the labeled pool and retrain, for up to 10 iterations. Report the initial test accuracy (before self-training) and the final test accuracy.
